title: Vaerion Extension Manifest (D15.1, D15.4)
description: Every extension declares itself in a versioned manifest; an undeclared capability is denied fail-closed. Extensions are principals, not guests (Stage 15).

engine.description: Range against engine contract versions; a range excluding the running engine is refused (E2006, D15.4).

requestedCapabilities.description: Capabilities requested; granted only through the broker (D15.5). Minimal-request principle enforced.

surfaces.description: Exposed surfaces (subcommands/hooks) — additive per D18.11 posture.
